spans.s:
शुच् 1. शुच्, cl. 1. P. शोचति (ep. also A.
-ते), शुशोच, शोचिष्यति, अशोचीत्, शोचितुम्
(or शोक्तुम्, Vopa-deva
VIII. 79, 80

), to be grieved
or sorrowful, be afflicted; to bewail, grieve for (with
acc.); to regret, repent; to be absorbed in deep
meditation: Caus. शोचयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अशूशु-
चत्, to afflict, grieve, make sorrowful; to be sor-
rowful; to bewail: Desid. शुशुचिषति, शुशोचि-
षति: Intens. शोशुच्यते, शोशोक्ति; [cf. Goth.
hiufan; Angl. Sax. heaf, heofian; Old Germ.
huvo.]

2. शुच्, क्, f. sorrow, grief, distress, regret; calamity,
affliction.

शुच् 3. शुच्, cl. 4. P. A. शुच्यति, -ते (Ved.
also cl. 1. शोचति, -ते, and in some forms
apparently cl. 6. शुचति), शुशोच, शुशुचे, शोचिष्यति,
-ते, अशुचत् or अशोचीत्, अशोचिष्ट, शोचितुम् (Ved. Inf.
शुचध्यै, other Vedic forms शोचा = शोचस्व, शु-
शुग्धि = प्रकाशय, शुशुचित = दीप्यताम्, Ṛg-
veda

), to shine, be bright or radiant; to brighten,
illuminate; to burn, consume; to become clean or
pure, be pure; to yield moisture, be wet; to decay,
become fetid, stink: Caus. शोचयति, -यितुम्, to
brighten, illuminate; to make pure, purify: Desid.
शुशुचिषति, -ते, or शुशोचिषति, -ते: Intens. शोशुच्-
यते, शोशोक्ति.

4. शुच्, क्, f., Ved. brightness, lustre, radiance, (शुचा-
शुचा, with reiterated lustre, Ṛg-veda
III. 4, 1

सूच् सूच् (thought by some to be pro-
perly a Nom. fr. सूचि), cl. 10. P. सूच-
यति, असुसूचत्, सूचयितुम्, to pierce; to point out,
indicate, show, prove, make manifest; to betray, re-
veal, inform against, inform; to indicate by gesture,
gesticulate, communicate by signs, declare, relate,
tell; to trace out, ascertain, spy out, espy: Pass.
सूच्यते, Aor. असूचि: Intens. सोसूच्यते.
शुचा, f. sorrow, grief, distress; affliction.
1. शुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, grieved, sad, lamenting.
2. शुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, purified, pure, clean.

सूचित, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced, perforated; pointed
out, indicated, intimated, hinted; made known, in-
dicated by signs or gestures, communicated, told,
revealed; ascertained, known.

शुचत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. shining, pure.
—शु-
चद्-रथ, अस्, m., Ved. a proper N.

शुचन्ति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a person under the
especial protection of the Aśvins.

शुचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to modern
scholars) observed, seen of men; shining, (according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
, and Nirukta
= दीप्यमान.)

शुचि, इस्, इस्, इ, bright, resplendent, clear, clean,
cleansed, purified, pure; white; virtuous, holy, in-
nocent, unsullied, undefiled, pious; correct, honest,
upright, true, trusty, faithful, correct, accurate, free
from fault or error, guileless, gentle; (इस्), m. white
(the colour); purity, purification (by ablution &c.);
innocence, virtue, goodness; correctness, accuracy;
acquittal; a pure man; a Brāhman; a faithful
minister, true friend; N. of fire or of a particular
fire (described as son of Antardhāna and brother of
[]
the fires called Pavamāna and Pāvaka); N. of a son
of Agni; oblation to fire at the first feeding of an
infant; the sun; the moon; the planet Venus or its
regent [cf. शुक्र]; the hot season (i. e. the months
Jyeṣṭha and Āṣāḍha); love, passion (= शृङ्गार-
रस); the condition of a religious student; a par-
ticular plant (= चित्रक); N. of Śiva; of a son of
Bhṛgu; of a son of Śata-dyumna; of a son of
Andhaka; of a son of Vipra; of the Indra of the
fourteenth Manv-antara; (इस्), f., N. of a daughter
of Tāmrā, wife of Kaśyapa (regarded as the parent
of water-fowl).
—शुचि-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. hav-
ing a pure birth, pure-born.
—शुचि-ता, f. or शुचि-
त्व, अम्, n. purity, brightness, cleanness, virtue,
holiness, innocence.
—शुचि-दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
having bright teeth.
—शुचि-द्रव्य, अस्, m. a proper
N.
—शुचि-द्रुम, अस्, m. ‘pure-tree,’ the sacred
fig-tree (= अश्वत्थ).
—शुचि-प्रणी, ईस्, f. ‘leading
to purity,’ sipping water, rinsing the mouth, &c.
—शुचि-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having a brilliant
relation (said of Soma as being related to fire).
—शुचि-भ्राजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having a bright
radiance, shining brightly.
—शुचि-मणि, इस्, m.
‘pure-jewel,’ crystal; a jewel worn on the head.
—शुचि-मल्लिका, f. Arabian jasmine (= नव-मल्-
लिका).
—शुचि-मुखी, f. the plant Sanseviera Zeyla-
nica.
—शुचि-रोचिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, having pure or white
light; (इस्), m. the moon.
—शुचि-वर्चस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, having pure splendor.
—शुचि-वर्चाय, Nom. A.
-वर्चायते, -यितुम्, to have pure splendor.
—शुचि-
वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, externally pure.
—शुचि-व्रत,
अस्, आ, अम्, whose acts are pure or holy, pious,
virtuous; having pure sacrifices.
—शुचि-श्रवस्, आस्,
m. ‘having bright renown,’ N. of a Prajā-pati.
—शुचि-स्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smiling with white
(teeth),’ smiling pleasantly, accompanied with a
sweet smile.
—शुची-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c.,
to become pure, to purify one's self.
—शुच्य्-उप-
चार, अस्, आ, अम्, performing holy actions.

सूचि, इस्, or सूची, f. piercing, perforating [cf. सू-
क्ष्म]; a needle; the point of a blade of grass,
point of a bud, sharp point of anything; a kind of
military array (according to Kullūka on Manu VII.
[]
187. placing the sharpest and most active soldiers in
front), a sharp file or column; a triangle formed by
the sides of a trapezium produced till they meet; a
cone, pyramid; indication by gesture, making signs,
gesticulation; a particular mode of gesticulating or
dancing; dramatic action; an index, table of con-
tents, catalogue, (see सूची-पत्त्र); (in astronomy)
the earth's disc in computing eclipses (or corrected
diameter of the earth).
—सूचि-खात, अस्, m. a sharp
pyramid or pyramidal excavation, an excavation of
a conical form, a pyramid, cone.
—सूचि-ता, f. needle-
work.
—सूचि-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. ‘having pointed
leaves,’ the pot-herb Marsilea Quadrifolia (= सिता-
वर).
—सूचि-पुष्प, अस्, m. the Ketaka tree,
Pandanus Odoratissimus.
—सूचि-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्,
divided into needles, split or bursting open at the
points of the buds.
—सूचि-रोमन्, आ, m. ‘having
needle-like or sharp bristles,’ a hog.
—सूचि-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, having a needle; having a pointed beak,
&c., pointed; (आन्), m. epithet of Garuḍa.
—सूचि-
वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, needle-faced; having a pointed
mouth or beak; (अस्), m. the mungoose; a mus-
quito.
—सूचि-शालि, इस्, m. a kind of fine rice.
—सूची-
कटाह-न्याय, अस्, m. the rule of the needle and
the boiler, (a phrase used to denote that when two
matters, one easy and the other more difficult and
important, require to be done at once, the more
simple should be despatched first.)
—सूची-कर्मन्,
अ, n. needle-work.
—सूची-दल, अस्, m. a kind of
pot-herb (= सितावर).
—सूची-पत्त्र, अम्, n. ‘in-
dicatory-leaf,’ an index, table of contents, catalogue;
(अस्, आ, अम्), having pointed leaves; (आ), f. a kind
of Dūrvā grass (= गण्ड-दूर्वा).
—सूची-पुष्प,
अस्, m. = सूचि-पुष्प.
—सूची-भेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be pierced or penetrated by a needle; gross,
thick, dense; palpable, tangible.
—सूची-मुख, अस्,
ई, अम्, needle-mouthed, having a pointed beak or
proboscis, pointed; (अस्), m. a bird; white Kuśa
grass; a particular position of the hands; (ई), f. a
female bird; (अम्), n. a diamond.
—सूची-रोमन्,
आ, m. a hog.
—सूच्य्-अग्र, अम्, n. the point of a
needle; (अस्, आ, अम्), needle-pointed, having a
needle-like point, acuminated; pointed.
—सूच्य्-
अग्र-स्थूलक, अस्, m. a sort of grass, Saccharum
Cylindricum.
—सूच्य्-आस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, needle-faced,
having a pointed beak or mouth; (अस्), m. a rat; a
particular position of the hands.
—सूच्य्-आह्व, अस्,
m. a kind of pot-herb (= सितावर).
सूची, f. a needle; an index, &c. See सूचि above.

शुचिस्, इस्, n. = शोचिस्, light, lustre, radiance, &c.
—शुचिष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, radiant; (आन्),
m., N. of a son of Kardama; epithet of Agni, (शु-
चिष्मः, voc. c. in Ṛg-veda

= दीप्तिमन्,
‘O resplendent being,’ i. e. Agni); (अती), f., N. of the
mother of Agni.

शुचीय, Nom. A. शुचीयते, -यितुम्, to become
pure or white.

शुच्य् शुच्य् (also written चुच्य्), cl. 1. P.
शुच्यति, शुशुच्य, शुच्यितुम्, to express
or squeeze out juice, distil; to perform ablution (in
the sense अभिषव, which some interpret to mean
‘religious bathing’).
सुच्छत्त्र सु-च्छत्त्र, &c. See p. 1119, col. 3.

सूचक, अस्, इका, अम्, indicative, indicating, prov-
ing, making manifest; betraying, informing; (अस्),
m. a piercer; a needle, any implement for perforat-
ing or sewing; a pointer out; an informer, tale-
bearer, traducer, spy; a narrator, teacher, instructor;
the manager or chief actor of a company; a Buddha;
a Siddha; a villain, scoundrel; a demon, imp; a
dog; a crow; a cat; a kind of fine rice.
—सूचक-
वाक्य, अम्, n. the information given by an in-
former.

सूचन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of piercing or per-
forating, perforation; pointing out, indicating, indi-
cation, intimation; informing against, traducing,
betraying; indicating by signs or gesture, gesticula-
tion; hinting, hint; information, informing; teach-
ing, showing, describing; spying out, espying, see-
ing; villainy, wickedness.

सूचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pointed out or indi-
cated, to be made known or communicated, to be
informed.

सूचिक, अस्, m. any one who lives by his needle,
a tailor, &c. [cf. सौचिक]; (आ), f. an elephant's
trunk or proboscis; a needle [cf. सूचक, p. 1130].
—सूचिका-धर, अस्, m. ‘having a trunk,’ an ele-
phant.
—सूचिकाभरण (˚का-आभ्˚?), अम्, n. a
particular drug or medicament, (apparently used as
a remedy for the bite of a serpent.)
—सूचिका-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having a pointed mouth or head;
having a needle-shaped point or end; (अम्), n. a
shell, the conch shell.
सूचितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = सूच्य.

सूचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, piercing, perforating; pointing
out, indicating; informing against, informing; spying
out; (ई), m. a spy, informer; (इनी), f. a needle;
night.

सूच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be indicated or pointed out,
to be made known, communicable.
